title: Diagnose: host-b disk /data 92% used, 39.6 GB free
body:
Fleet health probe at 2030-03-02 00:11:02 reported: WARN host-b disk /data 92% used, 39.6 GB free

Evidence collected on host-b by the ops loop (command: df -h /data; du -xh --max-depth=1 /data | sort -rh | head -5):
Filesystem  Size  Used Avail Use% Mounted on
/dev/sdx1   458G  419G   40G  92% /data
419G	/data
412G	/data/media
6.1G	/data/.cache

Diagnose it (L1: observe only, never change anything).

runs.summary:
## Diagnosis: host-b /data 92% used — L1 observe-only

### Evidence
```
/dev/sdx1 458G 419G 40G 92% /data
412G /data/media
```

### Findings
1. /data/media = 412G, 98% of /data usage.
2. /data/.cache = 6.1G, normal.

### Root cause
Observed: media directory dominates. Inferred (not verified): accumulated downloads.

### Recommendations (no changes made)
1. List the 10 largest entries under /data/media.
2. Check growth since previous card t_1a2b3c4d.
